 The State of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite Party
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

----- 
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Navin Kumar, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Manoj Kumar, A.P.P.
 ---
05/16.04.2024  Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with C.I.D. P.S. Case No.03 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506, 120B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Prabhat Kumar Sharma, learned A.J.C.-XVIII-cum-Spl.
Judge, CID, Ranchi.
It is alleged that co-accused persons and the petitioner used to work as agent of the Bank and help the C.C.L. Employees to get loan from the Bank for a commission.
Mr. Navin Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that only allegation against petitioner is that they used to help in getting the loan to C.C.L. Employees after taking commission.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that petitioner has got criminal antecedent.
Considering the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Prabhat Kumar Sharma, learned A.J.C.-XVIII-cum-Spl. Judge, CID, Ranchi or his successor in connection with C.I.D. P.S. Case No.03 of 2023.
